newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower in dull trading.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower on Thursday's new accounts day in a range-bounded trading in speculative scrips, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The KSE's 100-share index ended 4.55 points, or 0.30 percent, lower at 1,521.37 amid 178 losers and 64 gainers. Volume fell to 45 million shares from Wednesday's 63 million.
Market sentiment remained bearish throughout the day as jobbers refrained from taking fresh positions, a dealer at Ali Husain Rajabali said. "The sentiment is likely to remain bearish on Friday."
There was not much activity as major players continued to stay out, another dealer said. Activity revolved around select speculative scrips, including PTCL, HUBCO and ICI.
Hub Power fell 0.20 to 37.10 rupees and and Muslim Commcercial Bank 2.20 to 29.10. Pakistan Telecom rose 0.15 to 25.55 and ICI 0.20 to 23.
